Containment: User 'CORP\jsmith' credentials and MFA token reset via IAM system.

    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.summary: A ransomware incident was initiated via a phishing email that delivered a Cobalt Strike beacon. The initial access occurred when user jsmith (WS-FIN-042) executed a malicious PowerShell command from Outlook, leading to DLL sideloading via rundll32.exe. The ransomware payload (c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8) was detected before encryption began. Immediate actions included user credential reset and MFA token revocation. No containment or remediation actions were approved due to consensus failure.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Binaries {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon binaries via embedded configuration"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://github.com/rasta-mouse/ThreatCheck"
        hash = "b6a5c4d3e2f1b0a9c8d7e6f5b4a3c2d1e0f9b8a7c6d5e4f3b2a1c0d9e8f7b6a5"
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [2] 00 00 6A 00 E8 } // Call to Sleep
        $b = "software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run" nocase
        $c = { 31 C0 50 50 50 50 50 50 50 50 C3 } // Push 0x0 eight times
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and filesize < 1MB and 2 of ($a, $b, $c)
}

arguments.summary: A post-exploitation incident was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14), attributed to user jsmith. The compromise began with a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell command from Outlook, leading to the execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon via rundll32.exe from the Temp directory. Indicators confirm C2 communication over TCP/443 to a known malicious endpoint. The source host was promptly blocked at the firewall, and the user's credentials (password and MFA) were reset. No lateral movement or data exfiltration was confirmed during this phase. UEBA scored the activity as low risk due to normal access timing, highlighting a detection gap in behavioral analysis for compromised privileged accounts.

timeline.description: Initial low-severity scan alert (Nmap SYN) from internal IP 192.168.1.100 to 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). No immediate action taken.
User jsmith launched Outlook (outlook.exe).
Suspicious encoded PowerShell command launched from Outlook process (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe executed unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS detected Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic from 10.0.5.14 to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
Post-exploitation alert triggered. Incident INC-AP2-V5 created.
Firewall rule FW-RULE-0002 applied: outbound traffic from 10.0.5.14 blocked.
IAM/PAM system reset password and MFA token for user jsmith. Secure enrollment link sent.
